Question
========
In the context of plotting with `matplotlib.pyplot`, what does `plt.imshow(data)` typically do when `data` is a 2D array?

Answerlist
-----------
* Creates a line graph of data values
* Creates a heat-map (image) of the data values
* Creates a bar chart of data values
* Writes the data to disk as an image
* Prints the data to console in colour
* Converts the data to text

Solution
========
`plt.imshow(data)` shows a 2D array as an image (heatmap).
